ns2:section.sectionText: Intermediate study in electroacoustic composition techniques, focusing on refinement of craft and deepening conceptual understanding. Topics include experimental approaches to synthesis, sampling, effects processing, sound design, and digital audio editing/mixing as applied to concert art music. Students complete creative composition projects, supplemented with regular student presentations of in-progress work, finished compositions, and selected topics on electroacoustic music. Individual studio time is assigned. Prerequisite: MUS 407.
